title: Push notification system (end to end)
summary: Deliver timely, relevant notifications to millions of devices: token registry, preference checks, rate limiting, fan-out to APNs, rich content via extensions, and delivery/open tracking.
requirements: Transactional (order shipped) and marketing (campaign) notifications; per-user preferences and quiet hours.
Reliable, deduplicated, at most N per day per user; localized.
Rich content (images, actions), deep links, analytics on delivery and opens.
components: Device registry: (userID, deviceID, APNs token, app version, locale, timezone, permissions)
Notification service: templates, preference and quiet-hour checks, frequency caps, dedupe keys
Queue (Kafka/SQS) and sender workers holding HTTP/2 connections to APNs with token-based auth
Feedback handling: 410 Unregistered prunes tokens; retries with backoff on 429/5xx
Client: permission prompt strategy, token upload, Notification Service Extension, categories and actions, deep link routing
tradeoffs: APNs is best-effort; critical state must also be fetched by the app on open.
Provisional authorization delivers quietly without a prompt, increasing reach but lowering visibility.
Collapse IDs reduce noise (e.g. 'score updated') but lose intermediate updates.
Large fan-out campaigns need rate shaping to avoid backend stampedes when users tap at once.
body: **Permission strategy:** ask in context after the user sees value (pre-prompt screen), not at first launch; denied users can only be re-enabled in Settings.
**Client handling:** `UNUserNotificationCenterDelegate` for foreground presentation and taps; route the payload's deep link through the app router; track open events with the notification ID.
**Delivery tracking:** the Notification Service Extension can report 'received' (it runs for `mutable-content` pushes) so you can compute delivery rate.
**Time-sensitive vs passive** interruption levels and relevance score determine how Focus and notification summaries treat them.
**Live Activities** for ongoing state (delivery tracking) via ActivityKit push tokens.

POST https://api.push.apple.com/3/device/<token>
authorization: bearer <JWT signed with .p8 key>
apns-push-type: alert
apns-topic: com.example.app
apns-priority: 10
apns-collapse-id: order-123
apns-expiration: 1767225600

{"aps":{"alert":{"title":"Order shipped","body":"Arrives Tuesday"},
        "mutable-content":1,"thread-id":"orders","interruption-level":"time-sensitive"},
 "deeplink":"app://orders/123","image":"https://cdn.example.com/p/123.jpg","nid":"n-789"}
